resources.string: Save your settings, or everything, to a file locked with a password you choose. Open it on another computer or phone to bring it all back. On the computer, your online API keys go in the file too. Pairing codes and site sign-ins are never saved. "Export jobs as CSV" saves only your jobs, as a spreadsheet, without a password.
The computer also saves everything once a day and keeps the last 7 days.
Choose what to save. Jobs are only in “Export everything”.
AI filter: your prompt and excluded companies
Scanning: how often, sleep and sound
Port and network (they may differ on another computer)
Choose what to bring in. New searches are added; the rest replaces what you have now.

Lock the file with a password
Choose a password of at least 10 characters. You need it to import the file. It can’t be recovered if you forget it.
Your online API keys go in the file too, safe behind the password.
